name: remi
//: The Rust crate lives in src-tauri/; the Tauri CLI finds it automatically.

scripts.lint: npm run check && npm run format:check
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run check && npm run format:check && npm run build && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
